### Load dataset

For this model, we will use the following training and testing datasets:

* `prediction_dataset.csv`: For prediction purposes

* `regression_dataset.csv`: For training and regression purposes

* `vnm_.csv`: For constraints purposes

All data sets have been cleaned and contain no missing values.

```{r}
# Regression Dataset
regression_data <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "training_data/regression_dataset.csv"))

# Prediction Dataset
prediction_data <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "training_data/prediction_dataset.csv"))

# National GDP totals used to constrain the regression fit
constrained_data <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "_vnm_indicators/vnm_level0_gdp.csv"))

# Provincial GRDP per-capita targets used to calibrate 2025 level-2 predictions
provincial_grdp_data <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir,
  "_vnm_indicators/vnm_GRDPpc.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Provincial population totals (thousands) used as the aggregation constraint
provincial_population_data <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir,
  "_vnm_indicators/vnm_population.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Provincial population data are in thousands; convert to persons.
provincial_population_data[, as.character(2020:2025)] <-
  provincial_population_data[, as.character(2020:2025)] * 1000
```

### Shared training and holdout setup

The shared setup uses 2020–2024 for training and 2025 for the holdout. It
standardizes the common features and outcome using training-only statistics,
applies those transformations to the holdout, and computes temporal
extrapolation weights. A native OLS reference is generated from this same
design and saved for cross-model comparison; neural-network tuning and
calibration remain model-specific.

```{r}
model_setup <- prepare_model_comparison_setup(regression_data)
regression_data <- model_setup$regression_data
training_data <- model_setup$training_data
holdout_data <- model_setup$holdout_data
training_years <- model_setup$training_years
holdout_year <- model_setup$holdout_year
feature_columns <- model_setup$feature_columns
feature_means <- model_setup$feature_means
feature_sds <- model_setup$feature_sds
temporal_extrapolation_weights <-
  model_setup$temporal_extrapolation_weights
ols_comparison <- fit_ols_comparison(model_setup)
ols_reference_predictions <- ols_comparison$holdout
ols_reference_predictions$residual <-
  ols_reference_predictions$actual - ols_reference_predictions$predicted
ols_reference_predictions$residual_scaled <-
  ols_reference_predictions$actual_scaled -
  ols_reference_predictions$predicted_scaled
```

### Preliminaries

Let \(y_{it}\) be GRDP per capita for unit \(i\) in year \(t\), and let \(x_{it}\) contain standardized radiance, population, and pixel count. The neural network uses a single hidden layer with a linear output:

\[
\hat{y}_{it} =
f_{\mathrm{NN}}\left(x_{it},\,\alpha_{2021,t},\ldots,\alpha_{2024,t}\right).
\]

The year indicators represent the same year-specific effects \(\alpha_t\) used by the linear and ridge models. Since 2025 outcomes are held out during tuning, the 2025 year-effect inputs are formed by linearly extrapolating the 2020–2024 indicators using training-year trend weights. Hidden-unit count and weight decay are selected by 2025 holdout RMSE. The final model is refit on all available years and uses the 2025 year effect to predict level-2 observations.

```{r}
feature_columns <- c("mean_radiance", "population", "pixel_count")
scaled_feature_columns <- paste0(feature_columns, "_scaled")
feature_means <- vapply(training_data[feature_columns], mean, numeric(1))
feature_sds <- vapply(training_data[feature_columns], sd, numeric(1))


prepare_features <- function(data) {
  for (feature in feature_columns) {
    data[[paste0(feature, "_scaled")]] <-
      (data[[feature]] - feature_means[[feature]]) /
      feature_sds[[feature]]
  }
  data
}

add_year_effects <- function(data, effect_years, extrapolation_weights = NULL) {
  for (year in effect_years) {
    column <- paste0("year_", year)
    if (is.null(extrapolation_weights)) {
      data[[column]] <- as.numeric(data$year == year)
    } else {
      data[[column]] <- unname(extrapolation_weights[as.character(year)])
    }
  }
  data
}

training_data <- add_year_effects(
  prepare_features(training_data),
  training_years
)
holdout_data <- add_year_effects(
  prepare_features(holdout_data),
  training_years,
  temporal_extrapolation_weights
)
prediction_data <- prepare_features(prediction_data)

year_effect_columns <- paste0("year_", training_years)
model_predictors <- c(year_effect_columns, scaled_feature_columns)
design_formula <- reformulate(model_predictors, intercept = FALSE)
X_train <- model.matrix(design_formula, data = training_data)
X_holdout <- model.matrix(design_formula, data = holdout_data)
if (!isTRUE(all.equal(
      unname(X_train),
      unname(model_setup$X_train),
      check.attributes = FALSE
    )) ||
    !isTRUE(all.equal(
      unname(X_holdout),
      unname(model_setup$X_test),
      check.attributes = FALSE
    ))) {
  stop("Neural-network design matrices do not match the shared comparison setup.")
}
y_train <- training_data$grdp_per_capita
y_holdout <- holdout_data$grdp_per_capita

response_mean <- model_setup$response_mean
response_sd <- model_setup$response_sd
if (!is.finite(response_sd) || response_sd <= 0) {
  stop("Training outcomes must have positive, finite standard deviation.")
}
y_train_scaled <- (y_train - response_mean) / response_sd
holdout_total_sum_squares <- sum((y_holdout - mean(y_holdout))^2)
if (!is.finite(holdout_total_sum_squares) || holdout_total_sum_squares <= 0) {
  stop("The 2025 holdout outcomes must have positive finite variance.")
}
```

```{r}
fit_neural_network <- function(
  x,
  y,
  size,
  decay,
  seed,
  maxit = 3000
) {
  set.seed(seed)
  fit <- nnet(
    x = x,
    y = matrix(y, ncol = 1),
    size = size,
    decay = decay,
    linout = TRUE,
    maxit = maxit,
    MaxNWts = 5000,
    rang = 0.1,
    trace = FALSE
  )
  if (fit$convergence != 0) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Neural network did not converge (size=%d, decay=%g, seed=%d).",
      size,
      decay,
      seed
    ))
  }
  fit
}

predict_grdp <- function(model, newdata) {
  as.vector(predict(model, newdata = newdata)) * response_sd +
    response_mean
}
```

### 2025 holdout tuning

For each candidate hidden-layer size and weight-decay value, fit only 2020–2024 and predict the 2025 holdout using the extrapolated year-effect inputs. Each candidate uses a fixed seed so hyperparameter comparisons are reproducible.

```{r}
hidden_units_grid <- c(1, 2, 3, 5)
decay_grid <- c(0, 0.01, 0.1, 1)
nn_grid <- expand.grid(
  hidden_units = hidden_units_grid,
  weight_decay = decay_grid
)
nn_grid$holdout_RMSE <- NA_real_
nn_grid$holdout_R_squared <- NA_real_
nn_holdout_predictions <- vector("list", nrow(nn_grid))

for (grid_index in seq_len(nrow(nn_grid))) {
  candidate <- fit_neural_network(
    x = X_train,
    y = y_train_scaled,
    size = nn_grid$hidden_units[grid_index],
    decay = nn_grid$weight_decay[grid_index],
    seed = 401 + grid_index
  )
  prediction <- predict_grdp(candidate, X_holdout)
  residual <- y_holdout - prediction
  nn_holdout_predictions[[grid_index]] <- prediction
  nn_grid$holdout_RMSE[grid_index] <- sqrt(mean(residual^2))
  nn_grid$holdout_R_squared[grid_index] <-
    1 - sum(residual^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares
}

selected_nn_index <- which.min(nn_grid$holdout_RMSE)
selected_hidden_units <- nn_grid$hidden_units[selected_nn_index]
selected_weight_decay <- nn_grid$weight_decay[selected_nn_index]
best_holdout_predictions <- nn_holdout_predictions[[selected_nn_index]]
holdout_residuals <- y_holdout - best_holdout_predictions
selected_nn_model <- fit_neural_network(
  x = X_train,
  y = y_train_scaled,
  size = selected_hidden_units,
  decay = selected_weight_decay,
  seed = 401 + selected_nn_index
)
training_fitted_predictions <- predict_grdp(selected_nn_model, X_train)

write.csv(
  nn_grid,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "nn_model_hyperparameter_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
cat(sprintf(
  "Selected hidden units: %d; weight decay: %g; 2025 holdout RMSE: %.6f; R-squared: %.6f\n",
  selected_hidden_units,
  selected_weight_decay,
  nn_grid$holdout_RMSE[selected_nn_index],
  nn_grid$holdout_R_squared[selected_nn_index]
))
```

### Holdout metrics and diagnostics

The selected network is trained only on `X_train`, `y_train`; its training and 2025 holdout metrics are compared with the OLS reference fit on the same training inputs. Both sets of diagnostics are saved separately.

```{r}

ols_holdout_residuals <- y_holdout - ols_holdout_predictions

  training_data = training_data,

]
training_model_stats <- comparison_metrics[

holdout_diagnostics <- data.frame(

holdout_actual_fitted <- ggplot(holdout_diagnostics) +
```

### Refit selected model and training diagnostics

Refit the selected neural-network architecture on all available years. As in the linear model, the final model includes separate year effects from 2020 through 2025.

```{r}
all_years <- sort(unique(regression_data$year))
final_training_data <- add_year_effects(
  prepare_features(regression_data),
  all_years
)
final_year_effect_columns <- paste0("year_", all_years)
final_predictors <- c(final_year_effect_columns, scaled_feature_columns)
final_design_formula <- reformulate(final_predictors, intercept = FALSE)
final_X <- model.matrix(final_design_formula, data = final_training_data)
final_y <- final_training_data$grdp_per_capita
final_response_mean <- mean(final_y)
final_response_sd <- sd(final_y)
if (!is.finite(final_response_sd) || final_response_sd <= 0) {
  stop("All-years outcomes must have positive, finite standard deviation.")
}
final_y_scaled <- (final_y - final_response_mean) / final_response_sd

set.seed(1401)
final_nn_model <- nnet(
  x = final_X,
  y = matrix(final_y_scaled, ncol = 1),
  size = selected_hidden_units,
  decay = selected_weight_decay,
  linout = TRUE,
  maxit = 3000,
  MaxNWts = 5000,
  rang = 0.1,
  trace = FALSE
)
if (final_nn_model$convergence != 0) {
  stop("Final all-years neural network did not converge.")
}
final_nn_fitted <- as.vector(predict(final_nn_model, newdata = final_X)) *
  final_response_sd + final_response_mean
final_nn_residuals <- final_y - final_nn_fitted

final_ols_fit <- lm.fit(x = final_X, y = final_y_scaled)
final_ols_fitted <- as.vector(final_X %*% final_ols_fit$coefficients) *
  final_response_sd + final_response_mean

training_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  province = final_training_data$province,
  year = final_training_data$year,
  year_factor = factor(final_training_data$year),
  actual = final_y,
  nn_fitted = final_nn_fitted,
  nn_residual = final_nn_residuals,
  ols_fitted = final_ols_fitted,
  ols_residual = final_y - final_ols_fitted,
  mean_radiance = final_training_data$mean_radiance,
  population = final_training_data$population,
  pixel_count = final_training_data$pixel_count
)
training_diagnostics <- training_diagnostics %>%
  mutate(
    standardized_residual = nn_residual / sd(nn_residual),
    scale_location = sqrt(abs(standardized_residual))
  )
write.csv(
  training_diagnostics,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "nn_model_all_year_refit_diagnostics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

training_total_sum_squares <- sum((final_y - mean(final_y))^2)
final_refit_model_stats <- data.frame(
  model = c("Neural network", "Ordinary least squares reference"),
  R_squared = c(
    1 - sum(training_diagnostics$nn_residual^2) /
      training_total_sum_squares,
    1 - sum(training_diagnostics$ols_residual^2) /
      training_total_sum_squares
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean(training_diagnostics$nn_residual^2)),
    sqrt(mean(training_diagnostics$ols_residual^2))
  )
)
print(final_refit_model_stats, row.names = FALSE)
```

### 2025 level-2 predictions

Predict each level-2 unit using the final model, then apply an additive province adjustment so the level-2 population-weighted prediction total equals 2025 provincial GRDP per capita multiplied by the official provincial population. The adjustment uses the level-2 population sum as its denominator, so differing level-2 population coverage does not change the official target. Since GRDP per capita cannot be negative, the model predictions are floored at zero and the provincial adjustment is solved with that floor active. The non-negative unadjusted prediction and province adjustment are retained in the output.

```{r}
if (anyNA(prediction_data$year) || any(prediction_data$year != 2025)) {
  stop("The level-2 prediction dataset must contain only 2025 observations.")
}
if (any(!complete.cases(prediction_data[, c(
  "name", "level_1", "population", "mean_radiance", "pixel_count"
)]))) {
  stop("The level-2 prediction data contains missing required values.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(prediction_data$population)) ||
    any(prediction_data$population < 0)) {
  stop("Level-2 populations must be finite and non-negative.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(paste(prediction_data$level_1, prediction_data$name, sep = "\r"))) {
  stop("The level-2 prediction data contains duplicate units within a province.")
}

prediction_data <- add_year_effects(prediction_data, all_years)
prediction_X <- model.matrix(final_design_formula, data = prediction_data)
if (!identical(colnames(prediction_X), colnames(final_X))) {
  stop("Level-2 prediction design does not match the final neural-network model.")
}
raw_predictions <- as.vector(
  predict(final_nn_model, newdata = prediction_X)
) * final_response_sd + final_response_mean
if (any(!is.finite(raw_predictions))) {
  stop("Neural-network level-2 predictions must be finite.")
}

calibrate_nonnegative_additive <- function(
  raw_predictions,
  population,
  target_total
) {
  if (length(raw_predictions) == 0 ||
      length(raw_predictions) != length(population) ||
      any(!is.finite(raw_predictions)) ||
      any(!is.finite(population)) ||
      any(population < 0) ||
      !is.finite(target_total) ||
      target_total <= 0) {
    stop("Non-negative calibration requires finite predictions, non-negative population, and a positive target total.")
  }
  population_total <- sum(population)
  if (!is.finite(population_total) || population_total <= 0) {
    stop("Non-negative calibration requires positive total population.")
  }

  nonnegative_raw_predictions <- pmax(raw_predictions, 0)
  weighted_total <- function(adjustment) {
    sum(population * pmax(nonnegative_raw_predictions + adjustment, 0))
  }
  lower <- -max(nonnegative_raw_predictions) - 1
  upper <- target_total / population_total -
    min(nonnegative_raw_predictions) + 1
  for (iteration in seq_len(100)) {
    adjustment <- lower + (upper - lower) / 2
    if (weighted_total(adjustment) < target_total) {
      lower <- adjustment
    } else {
      upper <- adjustment
    }
  }

  adjustment <- lower + (upper - lower) / 2
  calibrated_predictions <-
    pmax(nonnegative_raw_predictions + adjustment, 0)
  calibration_error <- sum(population * calibrated_predictions) - target_total
  if (any(!is.finite(calibrated_predictions)) ||
      any(calibrated_predictions < 0) ||
      abs(calibration_error) >
        1e-8 * max(abs(target_total), 1)) {
    stop("Non-negative provincial calibration failed to meet its target.")
  }

  list(
    raw_predictions = nonnegative_raw_predictions,
    adjustment = adjustment,
    calibrated_predictions = calibrated_predictions
  )
}

prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025 <- provincial_grdp_data[["2025"]][
  match(prediction_data$level_1, provincial_grdp_data$province)
]
prediction_data$province_population_2025 <- provincial_population_data[["2025"]][
  match(prediction_data$level_1, provincial_population_data$province)
]
if (anyNA(prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025) ||
    any(!is.finite(prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025)) ||
    anyNA(prediction_data$province_population_2025) ||
    any(!is.finite(prediction_data$province_population_2025)) ||
    any(prediction_data$province_population_2025 <= 0)) {
  stop("Missing or invalid 2025 provincial GRDP-per-capita or population target.")
}

province_names <- sort(unique(prediction_data$level_1))
province_adjustments <- setNames(numeric(length(province_names)), province_names)
nonnegative_raw_predictions <- pmax(raw_predictions, 0)
calibrated_predictions <- numeric(length(raw_predictions))
for (province in province_names) {
  index <- which(prediction_data$level_1 == province)
  target_total <- prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025[index[1]] *
    prediction_data$province_population_2025[index[1]]
  calibration <- calibrate_nonnegative_additive(
    raw_predictions = raw_predictions[index],
    population = prediction_data$population[index],
    target_total = target_total
  )
  nonnegative_raw_predictions[index] <- calibration$raw_predictions
  province_adjustments[[province]] <- calibration$adjustment
  calibrated_predictions[index] <- calibration$calibrated_predictions
}

prediction_data$raw_grdp_per_capita <- nonnegative_raw_predictions
prediction_data$province_adjustment <-
  unname(province_adjustments[prediction_data$level_1])
prediction_data$predicted_grdp_per_capita <- calibrated_predictions

province_check <- do.call(rbind, lapply(province_names, function(province) {
  index <- which(prediction_data$level_1 == province)
  level2_population <- sum(prediction_data$population[index])
  province_population <- prediction_data$province_population_2025[index[1]]
  target_total <- prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025[index[1]] *
    province_population
  predicted_total <- sum(
    prediction_data$population[index] *
      prediction_data$predicted_grdp_per_capita[index]
  )
  data.frame(
    province = province,
    population = province_population,
    level2_population = level2_population,
    target_grdp_per_capita = prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025[index[1]],
    predicted_grdp_per_capita = predicted_total / province_population,
    target_total_grdp = target_total,
    predicted_total_grdp = predicted_total,
    difference = predicted_total - target_total
  )
}))
if (any(abs(province_check$difference) >
        1e-8 * pmax(abs(province_check$target_total_grdp), 1))) {
  stop("Calibrated level-2 predictions do not match all provincial GDP targets.")
}

level2_predictions <- data.frame(
  level_2 = prediction_data$name,
  level_1 = prediction_data$level_1,
  year = prediction_data$year,
  population = prediction_data$population,
  province_population_2025 = prediction_data$province_population_2025,
  raw_grdp_per_capita = prediction_data$raw_grdp_per_capita,
  province_adjustment = prediction_data$province_adjustment,
  predicted_grdp_per_capita = prediction_data$predicted_grdp_per_capita,
  province_grdp_per_capita_target_2025 = prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025
)
prediction_output <- file.path(
  data_output_dir,
  "nn_model_level2_predictions.csv"
)
write.csv(level2_predictions, prediction_output, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(
  province_check,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "nn_model_province_constraint_check.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    model = final_nn_model,
    formula = final_design_formula,
    feature_columns = feature_columns,
    feature_means = feature_means,
    feature_sds = feature_sds,
    calibration_population = "official provincial 2025 population",
    prediction_floor = 0,
    level2_calibration = "additive province adjustment with non-negative prediction floor",
    response_mean = final_response_mean,
    response_sd = final_response_sd,
    year_effects = all_years,
    hidden_units = selected_hidden_units,
    weight_decay = selected_weight_decay,
    training_seed = 1401,
    holdout_metrics = nn_grid[selected_nn_index, ],
    holdout_model_stats = holdout_model_stats,
    training_model_stats = training_model_stats
  ),
  file.path(model_output_dir, "neural_network_model.rds")
)

print(province_check, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Wrote level-2 predictions to", prediction_output, "\n")
head(level2_predictions)
```
